title: Model or native selector
text: Rows store a base-model ID without native effort/speed suffixes. Placement expands observed native selectors; observed model/effort facts outrank requested launch stamps. Known older catalog models without explicit rows demote exactly one class at the same effort; older bottom-class models and single-class Grok refuse. A placeholder selection (Cursor Auto, a harness default) names no model, so work admission refuses it and names the harness setting that hides the model.
